cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: the paved square before a city gate tower — standing; a grand museum hall with marble statues at night — holds a freshly printed instant photo up to the light; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — rests a red oil-paper umbrella open on her shoulder; a quiet city tram-stop platform at dawn — she is delightedly taking a first bite from a very large steamed breakfast bun before the tram arrives; a small outdoor carnival rehearsal yard with striped fabric pavilions — she is trying the padded seat of a miniature fairground ride; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — kneeling on the ground; a wind-rippled desert dune trail — lying on her left side; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — adjusts the height of the stand holding a microphone; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — seated on a chair; a training gym with a heavy bag — standing
